prompt.project_info: Create a lively outdoor music-festival portrait at night with a water cannon and colorful stage lighting.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult blonde woman posing naturally beside a metal barricade in front of a large cheering crowd. She wears a pink cropped tank top and high-waisted floral denim shorts, with a candid yet stylish expression and relaxed three-quarter pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait framing with the adult subject in the foreground, a large water cannon spraying a sparkling arc behind her, metal barricade and dense crowd across the middle ground, palm trees, tents and city buildings in the distance.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Colorful stage lights and dynamic night highlights sparkle through the water mist, with realistic crowd illumination and an energetic summer festival atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical festival photography, full-frame camera with 35mm lens, natural perspective, crisp subject focus, realistic water droplets and crowd detail, subtle low-light grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical festival portrait of one generic approved adult blonde woman at a lively outdoor music festival at night, posing naturally beside a metal barricade in front of a large cheering crowd, pink cropped tank top and high-waisted floral denim shorts, a large water cannon spraying sparkling mist behind her, colorful stage lights, palm trees and city buildings in the background, vibrant nightlife atmosphere, energetic crowd, candid yet stylish pose, sharp realistic lighting, natural skin and fabric texture, no logos, no watermark.
